native_ir_cache_note: Legacy and extracted FP32 baseline graphs match and native compile cache reuses the legacy binary; only legacy path emits IR. All new precision variants emit their own IR. No claim of an independent baseline recompile.
finding: BF16 AV preserves isolated accuracy: self error 0.01290 to 0.01293, cross 0.00644 to 0.00618. Isolated measured times fall about 13% self and 3% cross vs the extracted FP32 baseline, but these millisecond operator timings do not predict full-flow speed. BF16 QK raises self error to 0.0999; its CPU quantization diagnostic already incurs 0.1014, so keep QK FP32 for the next full-flow candidate.
decision: Run the BF16 AV candidate on the complete real-poster sampler and compare topology. Refresh the FP32 baseline after arithmetic extraction to verify full-model output stability. No default or acceptance-gate change.
tests: 30 focused CPU checks pass: intended matrix dtypes, analytic uniform attention, exact FP32 legacy arithmetic, original learned QKV/LoRA/projection reconstruction, preserved parameter identities/values and outer dtype. Hardware all eight cases repeat bitwise, no fallback, and both extracted baselines equal legacy expressions bitwise.
retention: All nonduplicate output tensors retained; legacy outputs equal extracted FP32 outputs. Original sealed QKV fixtures in result033. Raw report records original output-file hash outside Git.
